architecture_facts: mcp-use ships a typescript and a python sdk so a build sdk step is how every server starts
the inspector previews and debugs a running server, both a hosted and an open source build
the cli deploy command pushes straight to manufact cloud once you are signed in
manufact cloud adds observability, metrics, logs, and branch deployments on top of the open source cli deploy
mcp apps are react widgets auto discovered from a resources folder, no manifest wiring required
the inspector attaches automatically the moment a server calls listen, no separate process to run
tool schemas validate with zod in typescript and pydantic in python
surprising_detail: MCP Apps are just React components dropped in a resources/ folder. The SDK auto-discovers and serves them. No manifest file, no registration step.
